---
name: Skill Proposal
about: Propose a new skill for the workflow
title: "[SKILL] "
labels: skill-proposal
---

## Skill Name
Proposed name (e.g., s36-incident-response)

## Phase
Which phase does this skill belong to? (e.g., Phase 7: Verification & Observability)

## Problem Statement
What gap in the workflow does this skill fill?

## Proposed Workflow
Step-by-step description of what this skill would do.

## Input Contract
What does this skill need as input? (from which other skills?)

## Output Contract
What does this skill produce? (for which downstream skills?)

## AI Agent Integration
Which Harness AI agent would handle this? (DevOps, Reliability, SRE, Test, FinOps, AppSec/STO, or None)

## Autonomy Level
- Current: L? (L0-L4)
- Target: L? (L0-L4)

## References
Any papers, tools, or projects that inspired this skill.
